snippet.title: Dexter: Slice Coming Soon to iOS and Android! - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Launching this Halloween, SHOWTIME will debut a new DEXTER mobile game. The puzzle game, developed by Gazillion, will be available on Android and iOS. Subscribe to see the launch trailer featuring Harry Morgan himself, James Remar!

More details coming to these social media channels: 
https://www.facebook.com/DexterSliceGame/
https://twitter.com/DexterSlice 
https://www.instagram.com/dexterslice/
http://dexterslice.tumblr.com
